title: Umphefumlo ozinikeleyo welangatye elingcwele
intro: Phambi kwakho kukho ibali lenkalipho engaqhelekanga, apho umntu omnye waba nesibindi sokuphikisa iinkolelo ezinzulu kakhulu kwimpucuko yonke. Landela la mazwi athethwayo kwixesha elidlulileyo, kwaye uya kufumanisa ubomi obuphawulwe lukholo olungenakugungqiswa, ukusinda okumangalisayo, kunye nokubekwa kweziseko eziya kuyila uhambo lokomoya lweebhiliyoni. Landela umkhondo ngamnye ngononophelo - umlilo ongcwele usakhumbula.
clues: Ndazalelwa kwikhaya elalihlonela izidalwa zasezulwini nezithixo eziqingqiweyo, kodwa kukho into ethile engaphakathi kum eyayingavumi oko babekunqula.
Ndema nxamnye nomlawuli onamandla welizwe lam, ndaphula izithixo ezazinqulwa ngabantu bam, ndaza ndathi nguMdali wamazulu kuphela ofanele ukunqulwa.
Kwayalelwa ukuba kutshiswe umlilo egameni lam, kodwa ndathi Lowo ndimkhonzayo yedwa uza kundisindisa — kwaye amalangatye ayalelwa ukuba aphole kwaye akhuseleke.
Ndashiya yonke into endiyaziyo ngomyalelo kaThixo, ndihambahamba kwiintlambo ezibharhileyo nosapho lwam, ndithembele kwisibonelelo endandingasiboni.
Simi ecaleni konyana wam wamazibulo kwintlambo engenanto, sakha kunye iziseko zendlu engcwele, indawo engcwele eyenzelwe bonke abazithobayo.
Ndibizwa ngokuba nguKhalilullah — umhlobo osenyongweni woNonceba — kwaye igama lam lahlala linxulunyaniswa nokholo lokuzinikela nokuzithoba.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
